notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Ladies and gentlemen!

Here's the new update for you. The game has now two new game modes. FreeRoam and DriveReplay. FreeRoam lets you drive and walk and whatever in a scene freely. In a DriveReplay -mode you can chase your ealier self or park your car on a middle of raceway a (or how you ever wanted or not) to watch and feel how'd you drifted earlier.
And latest but not fakest, you can now make your own custom controls! Just go in to Button Config and fire some controls to the labels and tell to the game how you want to control cars.
Keep up, drift somehow, smoke the tires, make smile, eat, sleep and play!
New trailer is coming so let's hope you don't need a truck. See you back in the future!
